name: Xinyan Apple Electric Massager - Random Colour
description:
Xinyan Apple Electric Massager – Multicolor

Relax and relieve muscle tension anytime with the Xinyan Apple Electric Massager, a compact and versatile handheld massager designed for full-body comfort.

Key Features:

Dual Power Options: Operates via USB connection (cable included) or battery-powered (batteries not included).

Versatile Massage: Effective for head, neck, shoulders, hips, chest, and face.

Deep Muscle Relief: Powerful vibrations reach deep into muscles to reduce pain and soreness.

Portable & Compact: Small, exquisite design makes it easy to carry and use anywhere – at home, office, or on-the-go.

Bonus Head Massager: Comes with a free head massager for added relaxation.

Package Includes:

1 × Xinyan Electric Massager

1 × USB Cable

Bonus: 1 × Head Massager

Perfect For: Stress relief, muscle relaxation, and convenient massage therapy anywhere.
